title: Final Weekend at the Gold Medal Show
content: This Sunday in Los Angeles, two artists I admire will lead tours of theGold Medal Showat the Natural History Museum.• 1:30 p.m. - William Stout: Bringing Back the Dinosaurs• 2:30 p.m. - William Wray: Urban Subjects and Redefining the Landscape.I have two paintings in the show, one from Dinotopia and the other a paleoart piece.-----Gold Medal Show of the California Art Club Ends Sunday, July 1
